_doc: Traducción al inglés de animacion-3d.html. La estructura vive en la página española; aquí solo el texto. Genera con ./i18n/gen-en.py
Explora la figurita 3D de ontos: gírala,: Explore the ontos 3D figurine in your browser: turn it, resize it and try its gestures, poses and animations.
Esta experiencia interactiva necesita Ja: This interactive experience requires JavaScript. Enable it to use the experience, or return to Applications to explore the other work.
Figurita 3D de ontos. Arrastra para gira: 3D ontos figurine. Drag to rotate in any direction; pinch or use the wheel to change its size. Keyboard: arrows to rotate, plus and minus to zoom, Home to centre and H to wave.
La figura necesita WebGL. Puedes visitar: The figure needs WebGL. You can visit the 2D playground.
Arrastra para girar · pellizca o usa la: Drag to rotate · pinch or use the wheel to zoom
Puedes mirar por delante, detrás, arriba: Look from the front, back, above and below. Dragging stops auto rotation. “Life” enables breathing and small gestures; turn it off to observe the figure still. “Figure only” fills the screen with ontos; return with the top button or Escape.
Con el lienzo enfocado: flechas para gir: With the canvas focused: arrows to rotate, <kbd>+</kbd> and <kbd>−</kbd> to resize, <kbd>Home</kbd> to reset the view and <kbd>H</kbd> to wave. Centre also restores the standing pose.
